runs.content: Pfizer beat Q3 and raised FY26 revenue and EPS guidance yet trades at ~10x forward with a 5.6% yield, a defensive Burry-aligned entry on an AI-capex rout (S&P −4.4%, VIX 28); NDAQ was trimmed for capacity at +1.16% and no stops or targets triggered.

Lowe's (17.7x forward P/E, ~20% below its 52-week high) reclaimed its 200-day average as the Democratic midterm sweep cut oil 8.4% and made consumer discretionary the leading sector; AUTO hit T1 at 570.80p and LDOS was trimmed for capacity at −2.99%.
